title: Spot the Clock Glitch
constraints: Intended behavior: `count` increments on every rising edge of `clk` while the (latched) enable is 1, via a **gated clock** `gclk`. `rst` is an asynchronous reset that clears `count`.

The enable may change at **any** time, including while `clk` is high. `gclk` must never glitch: it is `clk` masked by an enable that was stable during the whole high phase (latched while `clk` is low).
The starter code has **1 bug**. Keep the gated-clock architecture: fix it, don't replace it with a clock enable.
hints: Submit the starter and look at the waveform around the first failing time: what happens to `gclk` when `en` rises while `clk` is high?
An AND gate on a clock is only safe if its other input can't change while the clock is high.

examples.title: glitch
examples.input: en rises in the middle of a high phase

examples.check: count matches the enabled clock edges
examples.title: count
examples.expected: count = number of enabled rising edges

wave_windows.title: fixed design: enable toggling at arbitrary times
